rationale: Lorenzo brings direct expertise in ML data services and annotation at Abaka AI, while Udula is an ML engineer building with Python and systems-level languages at RBC Borealis with robotics interests. They could explore how high-quality datasets and annotation infrastructure support embodied AI and robotics applications—areas where Abaka's pre- and post-training data solutions could directly enable Udula's project work.
intro_message: Lorenzo, meet Udula Abeykoon — an ML engineer at RBC Borealis working on robotics who could benefit from understanding how Abaka AI's data annotation services power embodied AI systems.
